name: MaterialFusion
definition: MaterialFusion is an enhanced conventional 3D inverse rendering pipeline that incorporates a 2D prior on texture and material properties to recover an object’s geometry, BRDF appearance, and environmental illumination from multi-view images under unknown illumination.
summary: MaterialFusion is a 3D inverse rendering pipeline that reconstructs geometry, PBR materials, and lighting from multi-view images by incorporating a 2D diffusion prior to ensure physically plausible and disentangled results.
